<!-- Generated by `make docs-gen` from the code. Do not edit: change the code and regenerate. -->

Puts a forecast on each item: the daily highs and lows of several weather models side by side, from Open-Meteo, for a city Polymarket lists temperature markets for or any place.

| | |
|---|---|
| Type | `weather.forecast` |
| Kind | Node |
| Inputs | `main` |
| Outputs | `main` |

Items that fail stop the execution, unless **Continue on failure** is on: then they leave on the `error` port instead. It only reads, so what fails is tried again 3 more times to begin with, as **Retry** says.

## Settings

| Setting | Kind | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| City (`city`) | text | no |  | One of the cities Polymarket lists temperature markets for: the station its markets resolve by, its time zone and its unit. Or the place by hand, below. One of `Amsterdam`, `Ankara`, `Atlanta`, `Austin`, `Beijing`, `Buenos Aires`, `Busan`, `Cape Town`, `Chengdu`, `Chicago`, `Chongqing`, `Dallas`, `Denver`, `Guangzhou`, `Helsinki`, `Hong Kong`, `Houston`, `Istanbul`, `Jeddah`, `Jinan`, `Karachi`, `Kuala Lumpur`, `London`, `Los Angeles`, `Lucknow`, `Madrid`, `Manila`, `Mexico City`, `Miami`, `Milan`, `Moscow`, `Munich`, `NYC`, `Panama City`, `Paris`, `Qingdao`, `San Francisco`, `Sao Paulo`, `Seattle`, `Seoul (Incheon)`, `Shanghai`, `Shenzhen`, `Singapore`, `Taipei`, `Tel Aviv`, `Tokyo`, `Toronto`, `Warsaw`, `Wellington`, `Wuhan`, `Zhengzhou`. |
| Latitude (`latitude`) | number | no |  | Without a city: the place's, like 40.7794. |
| Longitude (`longitude`) | number | no |  | Without a city: the place's, like -73.8803. |
| Models (`models`) | list of text | no | `gfs`, `ecmwf`, `icon` | The weather models, side by side: GFS, ECMWF, ICON and more; best is Open-Meteo's own blend. nbm and hrrr cover the US only. One of `gfs`, `ecmwf`, `icon`, `ecmwf_hres`, `aifs`, `gem`, `jma`, `ukmo`, `meteofrance`, `metno`, `knmi`, `dmi`, `cma`, `nbm`, `hrrr`, `best`. |
| Days (`days`) | whole number | no | `3` | How many days, today first: 1 to 16. |
| Hourly (`hourly`) | true or false | no | `false` | Also each hour's temperatures. |
| Unit (`unit`) | text | no | `city` | city: the unit its markets are in, °F in the US, °C elsewhere and by hand. F or C: that one. One of `city`, `F`, `C`. |
| Forecast field (`field`) | text | no | `forecast` | Where the forecast goes on the item. |

## Items

The items it receives, passed on with these fields added, `forecast` under the name **Forecast field** (`field`) gives. Decimals are text, so they stay exact; times are RFC 3339 text.

| Field | Kind | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `forecast` | object | The forecast. |
| `forecast.city` | text; or null | The city, when one was picked. |
| `forecast.station` | text; or null | Its markets' station, when a city was picked. |
| `forecast.latitude` | number | The forecast's grid point. |
| `forecast.longitude` | number | The forecast's grid point. |
| `forecast.zone` | text | The time zone its days and hours are in. |
| `forecast.unit` | text, one of `F`, `C` | Its temperatures' unit. |
| `forecast.models` | list of text | The models, as named in the settings. |
| `forecast.daily` | list of objects | A day each, the first today. |
| `forecast.daily[].date` | text | The day, like 2026-11-24. |
| `forecast.daily[].high` | anything | Each model's high, by its name: high.gfs; null where it has none. |
| `forecast.daily[].low` | anything | Each model's low, by its name. |
| `forecast.daily[].highMean` | number; or null | The models' highs, averaged. |
| `forecast.daily[].lowMean` | number; or null | The models' lows, averaged. |
| `forecast.hourly` | list of objects | An hour each, when asked for. |
| `forecast.hourly[].time` | text | The hour, local, like 2026-11-24T06:00. |
| `forecast.hourly[].temp` | anything | Each model's temperature, by its name. |
| `forecast.hourly[].mean` | number; or null | The models' temperatures, averaged. |
| `forecast.note` | text; not always there | What the city's markets resolve by, when not its station's METARs. |
